headline: Apple notified users in 99 countries of potential mercenary spyware attacks
summary: Apple has reportedly sent threat notifications to users in 99 countries, warning them of potential mercenary spyware attacks targeting their devices.
details: Apple has reportedly issued "Threat Notifications" to users in 99 countries, alerting them to potential mercenary spyware attacks. These notifications are designed to inform targeted individuals about sophisticated digital threats.

The company's support page clarifies that these attacks are typically state-sponsored and target specific individuals due to their identity or work. Such attacks are distinct from general cybercriminal activity.

Apple advises recipients to take the warnings seriously and offers steps to protect their devices and data. These steps include updating software, enabling Lockdown Mode, and seeking expert security advice.

The notifications aim to empower users to safeguard themselves against highly advanced and costly spyware, which is often used for surveillance. Apple does not disclose the identities of the attackers or the specific targets.

headline: Apple to require 18+ age ratings for dating apps and AI romantic companions
summary: Apple is implementing new age rating requirements for apps on its App Store. This change specifically targets apps with dating, relationship, and location-sharing features.
details: Apple today announced new age rating requirements coming to the App Store. These new rules specifically cover apps that include location-sharing features, as well as dating and relationship functionalities.

Under the updated guidelines, all such applications will now be mandated to carry an 18+ age rating. This move aims to enhance user safety and ensure appropriate content access, particularly for younger users.
